This '''mansion''' was the home of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Set Harth]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[New Sith Wars]]. In [[980 BBY]], [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] tracked him to the mansion, where she [[Duel in Set Harth's mansion|confronted]] him and convinced him to join her as her new apprentice before she took on her [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]].
